# oxide_system_ip_pool_silo_link (Resource)

This resource manages a system IP pool to silo link.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oxide_system_ip_pool_silo_link" "example" {
  ip_pool_id = "4f0e69ad-66b6-41c0-b727-7b0285b0c384"
  silo_id    = "9e199e45-01a6-43d3-8bc3-5b27726e67a6"
  is_default = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_pool_id` (String) ID of the system IP pool to link to the silo.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default IP pool for the silo. Only a single IP pool silo link can be marked as default for a given IP version and pool type.
- `silo_id` (String) ID of the silo to link the system IP pool to.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this resource, formatted as `IP_POOL_ID/SILO_ID`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is the format `${IP_POOL_ID}/${SILO_ID}`.
terraform import oxide_system_ip_pool_silo_link.example 4f0e69ad-66b6-41c0-b727-7b0285b0c384/9e199e45-01a6-43d3-8bc3-5b27726e67a6
```
